name: Ilinca Vrana
title: Keeper of the Feather
summary: The old midwife of the village under the castle, now a raven more often than not. A Keeper of the Feather who watches Old Bonegrinder from a dead oak, waiting for someone to help her get two children out.

guest_build.note: Joins for the assault on the mill (old_bonegrinder/ilinca:join) and leaves with the children.
